name: Fanned Toast Deck
note: Collapsed toasts are clip-path-trimmed to the front toast's measured height and offset so each peeks 10px; hover or focus fans them to measured stack offsets on a linear() spring. A registered <color> property morphs the tone through promise states, and pointer-capture swipes dismiss on distance or flick velocity while a single paused-when-hidden rAF clock drives every timer.

note: A bell-anchored panel that opens with a clip-path circle grown from the bell, day-grouped rows under sticky headers, and unread counts that roll through a registered <integer> property rendered with counter(). name: Grouped Activity Feed
note: Consecutive events on the same target fold into one summary row whose facepile fans out as its children unfold on a 0fr to 1fr grid track. Each row carries the ids of the events it holds, so a keyed FLIP can fold rows into their group (ghosts slide in), spill them back out, drop in live events or bump the group they merged into; a view() timeline lifts rows in as they scroll through the component's own scroller, and a scroll anchor holds your place while the new-events pill counts up.

name: Incident Status Banner
note: One registered <color> property carries the incident's severity: every surface, ring, chart stroke and service dot is derived from it with color-mix(), so a stage change from Investigating to Resolved transitions the whole banner through oklab in one declaration. A registered <percentage> fills the stage track, the error-rate chart is revealed with clip-path to the current update, and the banner collapses on a 0fr grid track between incidents.

name: Live Activity Pill
note: The pill is an SVG rect driven by a hand-rolled spring simulation (stiffness and damping per axis, sub-stepped), and the recording bubble splits off it through a feGaussianBlur and feColorMatrix goo filter. Compact and expanded HTML layers are laid out once at their final sizes and revealed each frame with clip-path insets computed from the same spring values, so the morph never touches layout; the frame loop sleeps when everything settles, the tab hides or the component scrolls away, while export and recording clocks stay wall-clock.

name: Batch Undo Tray
note: Archived rows leave as ghost clones that arc into the toast's tray while the survivors FLIP into the gap; each landing ticks the count, and archiving again inside the window grows the same batch and restarts a WAAPI timer that pauses on hover, focus, a hidden tab or scrolling away. Undo, or Cmd/Ctrl+Z, flies every row back out of the tray into its measured slot; :has() raises the bulk bar the moment a checkbox is ticked.

name: Live Presence Outline
note: Avatars live inside the outline and hop between sections on a FLIP measured across the move, the mover taking an arced keyframe path while everyone it displaced slides over; a scripted loop that pauses off screen and in hidden tabs keeps the room alive.
